intro: An engineering manager resume that shows the team and its results: people hired and grown, delivery improved, and products shipped.
tips: Give team size and what the team owned.
Show people outcomes: hires, promotions, retention.
Show delivery outcomes: what shipped, faster or more reliably.

basics.name: Rachel Thompson
basics.label: Engineering Manager
basics.summary: Engineering manager with four years leading teams of six to fourteen engineers, after eight years as a developer. I build teams that ship steadily and people who want to stay.

work.name: Fieldwise
highlights: Lead two teams (14 engineers) owning scheduling and the mobile app.
Hired eight engineers and promoted three; no regretted departures in two years.
Moved the teams to weekly releases from monthly, with fewer incidents.

work.name: Pixelbridge
work.position: Senior Software Engineer, then Tech Lead
highlights: Led a team of six building the customer portal used by 50,000 people.
Mentored five engineers, two of whom became tech leads.
